name: Create Structures
description: Two mods add buildings themed around Create.

pages.title: Create Structures
pages.text: Two mods add buildings themed around Create. They give a reason to explore, and their chests drop Create components. Neither needs a special trigger.

**Create: Structures Arise** adds, by name:

- a mine train
- a lost train station
- a pillager steampunk airship
- an air drop
- a mini sky village
- a crusher crane
- a fluid tank house
- a witch hut
- a bastion
- a ruined castle

pages.title: Train Track
pages.text: Create: Structures Arise includes a Mine Train and a Lost Train Station; see Trains.

These are good places to look for ideas: [#](2E5AAC)[trains](entry://transport/trains)[#]() at the mine train and station, [#](2E5AAC)[airships](entry://flight/airships)[#]() at the sky village and the steampunk airship. Sky structures are also in [#](2E5AAC)[Destinations](entry://flight/destinations)[#]().

**Create: Let The Adventure Begin** adds 62 structures with new loot, and a chance to fish up Create items.\
\
They include a railroad, oil rig, quarry, bunker, castle, kings castle, and houses in several styles.

pages.title: Brass
pages.text: Create: Let The Adventure Begin adds Create items to its loot and to fishing, so structure runs feed the same metals Create uses.
The oil rig is worth a look for [#](2E5AAC)[oil](entry://industry/tfmg_oil)[#]() fans. For loot rules in these chests see [#](2E5AAC)[Lootr](entry://exploration/lootr)[#]().
